Хранение логов

The process and policy of securely retaining security event and audit logs for a defined period to ensure availability for investigations, compliance, and forensic analysis.

Definition

The process and policy of securely retaining security event and audit logs for a defined period to ensure availability for investigations, compliance, and forensic analysis.

Operational example

Log retention policies ensured that critical event data was available during the forensic investigation months after the original incident occurred.
